[NFCT.6.3] **Iteration.** `ds_engine_for_each_fact(e, schema, visitor, user)`
visits every live fact (or, with a non-NULL `schema`, every fact of that
schema). The engine must not visit, by schema or unfiltered, or count in
`ds_engine_fact_count` ([NFCT.6.1]), a fact the lowering creates for its own
use, an `after` clause's timer or capture fact ([RFCS.6a.5]), or a fact the
engine synthesises, the clock tick ([LDET.5.8]), as the stream carries none of
them ([NCBK.2.6]). A pending `after` deadline is therefore not read through the
fact API. The visitor receives a borrowed
read-only fact pointer; return `DS_OK_R` to continue or any non-OK result to abort (which becomes the call's
return). Every `ds_engine_*` call the visitor makes on the engine being
walked, a read included, returns `DS_ERR_STATE` and does nothing
([RARC.13.17]): capture into `user` and act after iteration returns. A call on
a different engine is unaffected. Order is unspecified (hash-keyed); sort
captured results if you need stability.
